Design Practice: (A) Major Project Planning

The module begins the 'capstone' stage of the programme that allows students the opportunity to consolidate all their learning by conceptualising and executing a substantial communication project or campaign.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Demonstrate the ability to conceptualise and formulate a substantial design project.

+  Demonstrate integration and application of knowledge and skills to a professional standard.

+  Strategize design challenges considering audiences, user experiences, and design formats.

+  Exhibit problem-solving and critical thinking skills in the design practice.

+  Strategize design challenges considering audiences, user experiences, and design formats.

+  Produce a significant piece of design work that highlights technical proficiency, innovation, strategic thinking, and readiness for professional practice in the design industry.

+  Demonstrate proficiency in independent learning, project management, and self-evaluation skills.
